Team —

We're at the tail end of the Q2 hiring wave and need to coordinate the option award releases so offers with equity can go out the week after the 409A opinion lands. High-level asks:

- Confirm 409A effective date from Morgan & Co.
- Reserve a board slot (or two) for the retroactive award resolution; prefer the week of July 7 if possible
- Finalize the award list and quantities for payroll/K1'ing and downstream HR systems

I've attached the current candidate list and a draft resolution for the board. Markus — can you confirm capacity for a short supplemental board packet? Laura — please confirm that comp bands in the attached match what People approved last week.

Deliverables and rough timeline I had in mind:
1) Morgan confirms 409A effective date by EOD 6/18
2) Redwood legal preps final resolution + signature-ready PDF by 6/19
3) Board slot locked (or backup region) by 6/20
4) Offers live early week of 7/7

Attachments: award_candidate_list_q2.csv (CSV), draft-board-resolution.docx (DOCX)
